title: How to install the CLI
body: Run pip install our-cli then authenticate.

title: Requesting a refund
body: Refunds are processed within 5 business days.

title: Authenticating API requests
body: Use Bearer tokens from the dashboard.

title: Webhooks overview
body: Subscribe to event webhooks via the dashboard.

title: Rate limits
body: Default limit is 1000 req/min per key.

title: Setting up SSO
body: Configure SAML or OIDC in Settings > Security.

title: Python SDK quickstart
body: pip install our-sdk and init the client.

title: Pagination guide
body: Use cursor-based pagination for lists.

title: Migrating from v1 to v2
body: v1 is deprecated; see the migration table.

title: Exporting your data
body: Trigger a data export from the admin panel.
